**Triage Summary:**

Three critical and high-severity vulnerabilities affect `net-imap 0.4.21` (CVE-2026-42258, CVE-2026-42257, CVE-2026-42246, CVE-2026-42245), with one additional high-severity issue in `erb 4.0.3` (CVE-2026-41316). All five CVEs have available fixes and none are currently tracked as exploited in the wild (KEV=no), resulting in low EPSS scores (0.004–0.009) despite their severity ratings. The net-imap cluster suggests a single upgrade path may resolve multiple issues simultaneously.

**Recommended Action:** Approve the build with a requirement to upgrade `net-imap` to the patched version and `erb` to the latest available release before production deployment. Document the upgrade as a pre-release task rather than a blocker, given the absence of active exploitation and availability of fixes.
